subject: Laneway onboarding — procurement checklist, DPA execution, SOC 2 & subprocessor matrix
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@laneway.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@laneway.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Hi Jasmine,

We’re kicking off vendor setup for Laneway’s integration with Redwood. Procurement asked me to collect the following so we can route a PO and complete our internal security intake:

- Signed DPA (or a DocuSign link we can route to our legal)
- Current SOC 2 report or a read-only link to the report and a short summary we can share with stakeholders
- Full subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred)
- Instructions for how to route a PO (billing contact, email, any required vendor form)

I’ve attached our standard vendor questionnaire for you to fill (it’s quick). Also cc’ing procurement for visibility. Can we get these items by EOD Tuesday (PT)?

Attachments:
- Laneway-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Laneway AI
samir@laneway.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@laneway.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear checklist. Happy to get this moving. Summary below and next steps at the bottom.

What I’m attaching/providing now:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attached): one-page executive summary with scope and date (most recent audit 2025-11).
- redwood-subprocessors.csv (attached): full subprocessor inventory and data categories.
- DPA via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/redwood/dpa/abcdef123456 (please route to your legal).

How we prefer the PO to be issued
- Billing contact: finance@redwood.ai (Accounts Payable)
- PO email: invoices@redwood.ai
- If your ERP requires a vendor form, attach it to the PO email and include the PO number in the subject line.
- We accept ACH and wire; our ACH details are in the vendor packet we’ll attach after PO intake.

Internal help
- I’ve cc’d Ben Carter (vendor ops) to confirm ingestion once you send the PO to invoices@redwood.ai.
- Irene — looping for legal review of any DPA redlines (if Laneway proposes changes).

Next steps (proposal)
1) You sign the DocuSign DPA (or send back redlines).
2) Laneway issues PO to invoices@redwood.ai with completed vendor questionnaire attached.
3) Ben confirms PO ingestion + hands off for vendor activation.

Timeline: if you can sign/send PO by Tues EOD PT we’ll aim to have the vendor active within 3 business days after PO ingestion (assuming no DPA redlines).

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
- redwood-subprocessors.csv

Let me know if you need a short call to walk through the DPA.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Ops (Vendor Enablement)
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Procurement Ops <procure@laneway.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@laneway.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 02:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the quick turnaround.

We completed the vendor questionnaire and issued PO #34562 to invoices@redwood.ai (PDF attached). Please confirm once the PO is received and that there are no outstanding items for vendor activation.

Attachments:
- PO_34562.pdf
- Laneway-Vendor-Questionnaire-completed.pdf

Samir (Procurement)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, procure@laneway.ai
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list, and PO routing

Hi all — Ben here from Vendor Ops. Confirmed receipt of PO #34562 (PDF) in invoices@redwood.ai at 09:42 PT.

What I’ve done:
- Marked PO in the vendor ingestion queue (queue id: VQ-2026-1173).
- Staged the ACH vendor packet; drafting the final packet with banking details for Laneway.
- No DPA redlines received yet — Irene, please flag if you see legal concerns.

Next: once the DPA is signed and PO is fully processed (payment terms net-30), we’ll flip the vendor to active and share onboarding credentials. Expected timing: 1–3 business days post-PO processing.

Ben Carter
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@laneway.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list, and PO routing

All — quick note from Legal. I reviewed the DocuSign DPA link Jasmine provided and there are no material legal blockers in the current template. If Laneway proposes redlines, please send them as a single consolidated mark-up and we’ll prioritize review.

Ben — go ahead with vendor activation after we receive the signed DPA and confirm PO funds mapping.
